# Discover the Sondiko High Quality Versatile Cooking Blow Torch

**Enhance Your Culinary Experience**

The Sondiko Cooking Blow Torch is your essential partner in the kitchen and beyond. Crafted from professional-grade materials, this torch is designed with safety and durability in mind. The safety lock prevents accidental ignitions, while the broad base ensures stability, minimizing the risk of tipping over. Its long angled nozzle and burn-free finger guard provide a safe distance from the flame, making it a reliable and user-friendly tool for all your cooking endeavors.

**Refillable and User-Friendly**

Our kitchen torch is incredibly easy to operate. Simply refill it with any brand of butane gas (please note that butane is not included). To get started, slide the security lock to open it and ignite the flame using our advanced Piezo Ignition Technology. This portable mini torch is perfect for outdoor activities like camping and barbecues, offering versatility wherever you go.

**A Versatile Gift for Every Occasion**

This culinary torch is not just limited to cooking; it opens a world of possibilities. Perfect for caramelizing sugar on crème brûlée, glazing a baked ham, searing steaks, roasting bell peppers, melting cheese, or toasting breadcrumbs—its applications are endless. Additionally, it serves beautifully in lighting fireplaces, candles, and cigars, as well as in hobbies such as arts and crafts, jewelry making, welding, and various outdoor activities.

**Precision Control with Adjustable Flame Settings**

Experience total control with our adjustable flame feature. The Piezo Ignition Technology allows operation at any angle, even upside down, and with just one hand. The adjustable temperature regulator enables you to manage the flame temperature, reaching impressive levels of up to 1300 °C (2372 °F). For continuous flame mode, simply press the button to ignite, turn the safety lock clockwise, and enjoy automated operation for efficient baking and cooking.

**Universal Compatibility with Butane Tanks**

Worried about compatibility with butane tanks? Worry no more. The Sondiko kitchen blow torch is designed to fit all brands of butane gas—both long and short nozzle types. For a short nozzle tank, the included red adapter extends the nozzle, allowing you to refill effortlessly.

### Precautions for Optimal Use

- **Break Period:** Allow the torch to cool after 5 continuous minutes of use to extend its lifespan.
- **Safety First:** Keep out of reach of children and always handle away from flammable materials. Avoid direct sunlight exposure for prolonged periods and do not use when temperatures exceed 50°C (122°F).

### Instructions for Use

- **Ignition:** Set the fire ignition button to "OPEN," then press to light the flame. Release the button to extinguish.
- **Continuous Flame:** Rotate the ignition clockwise to "CLOSE" while the flame is lit, allowing for sustained use.
- **Flame Adjustment:** Slide the control to modify flame intensity.
- **Refueling:** Insert the butane refill canister vertically into the torch base. Wait for approximately 6 seconds before withdrawal. Expect to repeat this process about three times for a full refill, and allow a brief pause before reigniting.

- **Capacity:** 8-10g of butane gas
- **Flame Temperature:** Up to 2500°F (1300°C)
- **Material:** Aluminum alloy
- **Dimensions:** 12 x 6 x 15.5 cm (4.7 x 2.3 x 6 inches)
- **Net Weight:** 220g (0.48 lb)
- **Gas Type:** Butane (not included)

- 1x Butane canister extension nozzle

### Lounger Features and Usage Guide

#### Effortless Inflation
Inflating your lounger couldn't be simpler, even in breezy conditions. On a windy day, simply position the mouth of the lounger into the wind, and let nature do the work. If the wind is not strong enough, use a fan for a quick and easy fill-up right at home. Featuring a square-shaped headrest, this lounger is engineered to provide superior support for your back and neck. The carefully crafted ergonomic design ensures an unmatched comfort experience, making it the perfect companion for any leisure activity.

#### Versatile Indoor & Outdoor Use
This lounger is adaptable to a multitude of settings. Whether you're camping in the wild, hosting a backyard barbecue, enjoying a day at the beach, or simply lounging by the pool, it proves to be an essential item for every occasion.

Our SUHU Car Battery Charger is engineered for compatibility with all 12V and 24V lead-acid batteries, ranging from 6-150Ah for 12V and 6-100Ah for 24V. One of the standout features of our charger is its advanced reparation mode. Utilizing automatic detection for sulfation and acid stratification, it comes equipped with a simple "One Key to Repair" function. This sophisticated mechanism allows for real-time adjustments to the charging current, adapting effortlessly to various voltage conditions. Our robust design includes built-in circuit protection that safeguards against reverse polarity, sparks, overcharging, over-current, open-circuit behavior, short circuits, and overheating. # Introducing the Brightech Montage Modern Edition LED Floor Lamp 

Elevate your living space with the **Brightech Montage Modern Edition LED Floor Lamp**, a quintessential piece that seamlessly integrates with a wide variety of decor styles. Whether your aesthetic leans toward mid-century modern, traditional, or contemporary, this lamp’s sleek design is guaranteed to enhance your environment.

## Versatile Compatibility with Smart Home Devices

Experience the convenience of smart living with the Montage Modern, compatible with Alexa, Google Home, and Apple HomeKit. Imagine effortlessly controlling your lighting with just your voice! While a smart outlet is required (sold separately), the lamp's functionality is enhanced by its hanging drum shade, which directs light downward, making it an ideal companion for reading beside your favorite chair.

## Practical Design for Any Space

Standing at an impressive five feet tall, this floor lamp doubles as an arc lamp, gracefully arching over your sofa, armchair, or desk. With a weight of just 14 pounds concentrated in its sturdy base, it is remarkably easy to reposition wherever you need illumination the most. The weighted base ensures stability, while the user-friendly foot switch allows for effortless operation—simply tap to turn the lamp on or off.

## Long-Lasting Efficiency 

Included with your purchase is a state-of-the-art LED bulb, designed to illuminate your space for an astonishing 20,000 hours—equating to a lifespan of about 20 years with normal usage (approximately 3 hours per day). This efficiency translates to a 90% reduction in energy costs compared to traditional halogen or incandescent bulbs. Additionally, the LED technology minimizes the risk of burns, allowing you to move comfortably around your lamp without worry.

## Our Commitment to Quality 

We pride ourselves on the steadfast reliability of our products, which is why we proudly offer a comprehensive **3-year warranty**. This policy safeguards against any defects or malfunctions within that timeframe, reaffirming our commitment to your satisfaction.

## Stylish Design for Optimal Ambience

The **Brightech Montage Modern** is more than just a lamp; it’s a statement piece. The included LED bulb emits a soft white glow of 800 lumens at a color temperature of 3000K, creating the perfect atmosphere for living rooms, studies, bedrooms, or offices. The light-diffusing decorative shade enhances the ambience, making every moment spent in its glow feel warm and inviting. If you desire a different brightness, you can easily switch to a bulb of your preference—just note that the included bulb is not dimmable.

## Effortless Assembly 

Setting up your Brightech lamp is a breeze. With clear instructions and a simple diagram included, you can assemble it within minutes—no additional tools are necessary! Once your lamp is ready, simply tap the built-in footswitch, conveniently extending approximately four feet from the base, to bring your space to life.

### Shade Dimensions for Perfect Fit
- **Diameter**: 14.75 inches
- **Height**: 7.5 inches
- **Fitter Type**: Euro Style (shade ring is included and may already be in place on the socket) 

Transform your home today with the Brightech Montage Modern Edition LED Floor Lamp, where style meets functionality in the most exquisite way.

# Elevate Your Creativity with the Lusweimi 60" Adjustable Camera Tripod for iPad

The **Lusweimi 60" Adjustable Camera Tripod** is the quintessential tool for photographers, content creators, and professionals alike. At a remarkable height range of **17.3 to 60 inches**, this versatile tripod fits seamlessly into various applications—whether you are capturing stunning photographs, recording YouTube videos, engaging in live vlogs, or conducting video conferences. The lightweight design, crafted from high-quality aluminum and weighing in at just **1.6 pounds**, makes it an ideal travel companion, always ready to accompany you on your creative journeys.

## Universal Compatibility and Functionality 

Our **Universal iPad Holder with Cold Shoe** is designed to accommodate a wide array of devices, with adjustable width ranging from **4.7 to 9 inches**. This holder is compatible with an extensive range of products, including the **iPad Pro (12.9"/11"/9.7")**, **iPad Air**, **iPad Mini**, various **iPhones**, and select **Galaxy** devices. The inclusion of cold shoes allows for mounting additional equipment such as flashlights and microphones. To protect your devices, both ends of the mount feature anti-slip silica gel pads, ensuring they remain secure and scratch-free.

## Precision and Stability 

Our tripod boasts a **3-Way Head with Screw Attachment**, featuring a **1/4” screw** that optimally fits most smartphones and cameras such as **GoPro**, **Canon**, **Nikon**, **Sony**, **Ricoh**, **Olympus**, and **Fujifilm**. The tripod’s built-in level and convenient handle enable effortless adjustments, allowing users to switch seamlessly between horizontal and vertical camera orientations.

## Unmatched Stability 

Designed with a focus on durability, the **Lusweimi tripod** utilizes a unique trapezoidal pipe construction, featuring a maximum tube diameter of **20mm**. Constructed from high-grade aluminum and reinforced with robust plastic floor mats, this tripod surpasses competitors in sturdiness. It confidently supports up to **8 pounds**, ensuring a stable platform for any creative project.

## Comprehensive Package and Dedicated Support 

In addition to the tripod, your purchase includes a **Bluetooth remote**, an **iPad holder**, and a **carry bag**. Should you have any inquiries or require assistance, our dedicated **Lusweimi customer service team** is here to help, responding to all questions within **24 hours**.

### Included in the Box:
- 1 x Lightweight Tripod
- 1 x Phone & iPad Holder
- 1 x Carry Bag
